name: Manikya Pishti

sections.introduction: Manikya Pishti is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to prepared from ruby. This formulation is known to control vata and kapha doshas. This is used to treat problems related with mental, physical and sexual health.
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha Manikya – Purified Ruby 
 Rose water – quantity sufficient 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take ruby up to 10 grams and powder it. 
 Ground this powder with rose water for three to four days. 
 Make this mixture till its texture look as fine as collyrium. 
 Your pishti is prepared. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Manikya Pishti is an Ayurvedic medicine meant to manage various problems like oligospermia, psychosis and low immunity. It balances vata and kapha doshas in body. This medicine is considered as a good immunity booster hence it is an effective medicine for those who have the low defense mechanism and are prone to develop one and the other health issue. It supports the healthy brain functions and improves memory and intellectual power. This medicine works well to resolve the various problems like mental fatigue, stress, depression, insomnia, anxiety, loss of desire to eat, restlessness and many more. Manikya Pishti is known to be an effective medicine for heart problems. It helps to strengthen the heart muscles and maintains the proper blood supply throughout the body. It also regulates the healthy cholesterol and blood pressure in the body. In oligospermia, it enhances sperm production and also improves the quality of sperms.

fullContent:
Manikya Pishti 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, 137 – 138. 
 Introduction 
 Manikya Pishti is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to prepared from ruby. This formulation is known to control vata and kapha doshas. This is used to treat problems related with mental, physical and sexual health. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Manikya – Purified Ruby 
 Rose water – quantity sufficient 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take ruby up to 10 grams and powder it. 
 Ground this powder with rose water for three to four days. 
 Make this mixture till its texture look as fine as collyrium. 
 Your pishti is prepared. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Manikya Pishti is an Ayurvedic medicine meant to manage various problems like oligospermia, psychosis and low immunity. It balances vata and kapha doshas in body. This medicine is considered as a good immunity booster hence it is an effective medicine for those who have the low defense mechanism and are prone to develop one and the other health issue. It supports the healthy brain functions and improves memory and intellectual power. This medicine works well to resolve the various problems like mental fatigue, stress, depression, insomnia, anxiety, loss of desire to eat, restlessness and many more. Manikya Pishti is known to be an effective medicine for heart problems. It helps to strengthen the heart muscles and maintains the proper blood supply throughout the body. It also regulates the healthy cholesterol and blood pressure in the body. In oligospermia, it enhances sperm production and also improves the quality of sperms. 
 Indications 
 
 Heart problems 
 Low Immunity 
 Oligospermia 
 Weak intelligence 
 
 Dose 
 31.25 mg to 62.5 mg, two times a day with honey, butter or sugar etc. 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
